memoryBuilder.verseText: Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

sequence.prompt: What did the shepherd do when one sheep was lost? Put it in order.

items.label: Shepherd finds and carries it home

matches.prompt: Match each to what they mean.

pairs.right: Anyone who has wandered from God
What heaven does when we return

application.question: God searches for YOU like that shepherd — He never gives up! How does that make you feel?
application.followUp: Even if you wander, God does not stop looking for you. He leaves everything to find you — that is how much you matter to Him.
